### SAVI donors vs healthy baseline (unified compartments)

For **`SAVI`** and **`SAVI_treated`** donors only, we compare each donor’s **compartment proportion** (sum of mapped L3 types) to healthy **`predict_res`** draws matched on **`sex`** and **`age_decade`**. We then ask whether the atlas tail call (`higher` / `lower` / `consistent` vs healthy) agrees with the **paper’s expected direction** in SAVI (increased vs decreased).

```{r}
#| label: composition-savi-vs-healthy-compartments

baseline_compartment_draws <- predict_res |>
  dplyr::inner_join(
    paper_compartment_l3 |>
      dplyr::distinct(.data$paper_compartment, .data$cell_type),
    by = "cell_type"
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$age_decade,
    .data$sex,
    .data$paper_compartment,
    .data$.draw
  ) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    compartment_proportion = sum(.data$proportion),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

donor_sex_age_all <- example_proportions |>
  dplyr::distinct(.data$sample_id, .data$sex, .data$age_decade) |>
  dplyr::rename(sample_id_observed = sample_id)

# One reference table for all donors: tail test vs sex/age-matched healthy draws.
composition_matched_reference <- composition_paper_long |>
  dplyr::left_join(donor_sex_age_all, by = "sample_id_observed") |>
  dplyr::inner_join(
    baseline_compartment_draws,
    by = c("sex", "age_decade", "paper_compartment"),
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$sample_id_observed,
    .data$Category,
    .data$sex,
    .data$age_decade,
    .data$paper_compartment,
    .data$direction_in_savi,
    .data$proportion_observed
  ) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    healthy_median = stats::median(.data$compartment_proportion),
    healthy_hpd_lo = stats::quantile(.data$compartment_proportion, 0.025),
    healthy_hpd_hi = stats::quantile(.data$compartment_proportion, 0.975),
    p_above_healthy = mean(.data$compartment_proportion >= .data$proportion_observed),
    p_below_healthy = mean(.data$compartment_proportion <= .data$proportion_observed),
    empirical_confidence = 2 * pmin(.data$p_above_healthy, .data$p_below_healthy),
    direction_vs_healthy = dplyr::case_when(
      .data$p_above_healthy < 0.025 ~ "higher_than_healthy",
      .data$p_below_healthy < 0.025 ~ "lower_than_healthy",
      TRUE ~ "consistent_with_healthy"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

composition_savi_vs_healthy <- composition_matched_reference |>
  dplyr::filter(.data$Category %in% c("SAVI", "SAVI_treated")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    atlas_direction_simple = dplyr::case_when(
      .data$direction_vs_healthy == "higher_than_healthy" ~ "increased",
      .data$direction_vs_healthy == "lower_than_healthy" ~ "decreased",
      TRUE ~ "consistent"
    ),
    agrees_with_paper = dplyr::case_when(
      .data$direction_in_savi == "increased" ~
        .data$atlas_direction_simple == "increased",
      .data$direction_in_savi %in% c("decreased", "strongly decreased") ~
        .data$atlas_direction_simple == "decreased",
      TRUE ~ NA
    ),
    agreement_label = dplyr::case_when(
      .data$agrees_with_paper %in% TRUE ~ "agrees (atlas vs paper)",
      .data$agrees_with_paper %in% FALSE ~ "disagrees (atlas vs paper)",
      TRUE ~ "atlas consistent (no tail)"
    )
  )

composition_savi_vs_healthy |>
  dplyr::arrange(.data$Category, .data$paper_compartment, .data$sample_id_observed)

composition_savi_agreement_summary <- composition_savi_vs_healthy |>
  dplyr::group_by(.data$Category, .data$paper_compartment, .data$direction_in_savi) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_donors = dplyr::n(),
    n_higher = sum(.data$direction_vs_healthy == "higher_than_healthy"),
    n_lower = sum(.data$direction_vs_healthy == "lower_than_healthy"),
    n_consistent = sum(.data$direction_vs_healthy == "consistent_with_healthy"),
    n_agrees_paper = sum(.data$agrees_with_paper %in% TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_disagrees_paper = sum(.data$agrees_with_paper %in% FALSE, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_testable = sum(!is.na(.data$agrees_with_paper)),
    pct_agrees_paper = dplyr::if_else(
      sum(!is.na(.data$agrees_with_paper)) > 0L,
      100 * mean(.data$agrees_with_paper, na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(.data$Category, .data$paper_compartment)

composition_savi_agreement_summary

# Diagnostic: heatmap tail call vs observed relative to matched healthy median.
composition_naive_cd4_check <- composition_matched_reference |>
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$paper_compartment == "Naive CD4 T",
    .data$Category == "SAVI"
  ) |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    sample_id_observed,
    age_decade,
    sex,
    proportion_observed,
    healthy_median_matched = .data$healthy_median,
    delta_obs_minus_matched = .data$proportion_observed - .data$healthy_median,
    direction_vs_healthy,
    visual_check = dplyr::case_when(
      .data$direction_vs_healthy == "higher_than_healthy" ~
        "solid line should be RIGHT of dashed median",
      .data$direction_vs_healthy == "lower_than_healthy" ~
        "solid line should be LEFT of dashed median",
      TRUE ~ "solid line near dashed median"
    )
  )

composition_naive_cd4_check
```

### How much CTRL samples in data agree with our healthy baseline

In-study **CTRL** donors are the paper’s reference for “healthy”. If they are exchangeable with the Immune Atlas healthy baseline, each **CTRL** pseudobulk compartment proportion should fall inside the **sex/age-matched** predictive null (`direction_vs_healthy == consistent_with_healthy`). Deviations flag compartments where study controls already sit above or below the atlas before comparing SAVI.

```{r}
#| label: composition-ctrl-baseline

composition_ctrl_baseline <- composition_matched_reference |>
  dplyr::filter(.data$Category == "CTRL") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    agrees_with_healthy_baseline = .data$direction_vs_healthy == "consistent_with_healthy",
    baseline_agreement = dplyr::case_when(
      .data$direction_vs_healthy == "consistent_with_healthy" ~ "consistent with healthy",
      .data$direction_vs_healthy == "higher_than_healthy" ~ "higher than healthy",
      .data$direction_vs_healthy == "lower_than_healthy" ~ "lower than healthy"
    ),
    baseline_agreement = factor(
      .data$baseline_agreement,
      levels = c(
        "consistent with healthy",
        "higher than healthy",
        "lower than healthy"
      )
    ),
    atlas_strength = 1 - .data$empirical_confidence,
    direction_short = dplyr::case_when(
      .data$direction_vs_healthy == "higher_than_healthy" ~ "↑",
      .data$direction_vs_healthy == "lower_than_healthy" ~ "↓",
      TRUE ~ "·"
    ),
    tile_label = sprintf(
      "%s\n%.2f",
      .data$direction_short,
      .data$atlas_strength
    ),
    paper_compartment = factor(
      .data$paper_compartment,
      levels = unique(paper_compartment_l3$paper_compartment)
    )
  )

composition_ctrl_baseline_summary <- composition_ctrl_baseline |>
  dplyr::group_by(.data$sample_id_observed, .data$sex, .data$age_decade) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_compartments = dplyr::n(),
    n_consistent = sum(.data$agrees_with_healthy_baseline),
    n_higher = sum(.data$direction_vs_healthy == "higher_than_healthy"),
    n_lower = sum(.data$direction_vs_healthy == "lower_than_healthy"),
    pct_consistent = 100 * .data$n_consistent / .data$n_compartments,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(.data$pct_consistent), .data$sample_id_observed)

composition_ctrl_baseline_overall <- composition_ctrl_baseline |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_ctrl_donors = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$sample_id_observed),
    n_tests = dplyr::n(),
    n_consistent = sum(.data$agrees_with_healthy_baseline),
    n_higher = sum(.data$direction_vs_healthy == "higher_than_healthy"),
    n_lower = sum(.data$direction_vs_healthy == "lower_than_healthy"),
    pct_consistent = 100 * .data$n_consistent / .data$n_tests,
    mean_pct_consistent_per_donor = mean(composition_ctrl_baseline_summary$pct_consistent)
  )

composition_ctrl_baseline_overall
composition_ctrl_baseline_summary
```

```{r}
#| label: plot-composition-ctrl-baseline-heatmap
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 5.5
#| fig-align: center

ctrl_baseline_cols <- c(
  "consistent with healthy" = "#4DAF4A",
  "higher than healthy" = "#E41A1C",
  "lower than healthy" = "#377EB8"
)

ctrl_sample_order <- composition_ctrl_baseline_summary |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(.data$pct_consistent), .data$sample_id_observed) |>
  dplyr::pull(.data$sample_id_observed)

ctrl_heatmap_data <- composition_ctrl_baseline |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    sample_id_observed = factor(.data$sample_id_observed, levels = ctrl_sample_order),
    tile_label = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$agrees_with_healthy_baseline,

    )
  )

ggplot2::ggplot(
  ctrl_heatmap_data,
  ggplot2::aes(
    x = paper_compartment,

  )
) +

    color = "grey15"
  ) +

    values = ctrl_baseline_cols,

  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "CTRL donors: agreement with sex/age-matched healthy atlas (paper compartments)",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Green = consistent_with_healthy (",
      sprintf("%.0f", composition_ctrl_baseline_overall$pct_consistent),
      "% of donor × compartment tests cohort-wide). ",
      "Non-green tiles show direction (↑/↓) and tail strength (1 - empirical confidence)."
    ),
    x = NULL,
    y = "CTRL donor"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_bw() +
  ggplot2::theme(
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1, size = 8),

```

Each panel below is one **CTRL donor × paper compartment**: grey density = healthy **`predict_res`** draws for that donor’s **`sex`** and **`age_decade`**; coloured vertical line = observed proportion. Line colour matches the heatmap (green = consistent, red/blue = tail call). Text at each line reports **`p_above_healthy`** = P(draw ≥ obs) and **`p_below_healthy`** = P(draw ≤ obs) (same tail convention as gene-level tests).

```{r}
#| label: plot-composition-ctrl-baseline-density
#| fig-width: 20
#| fig-height: 15
#| fig-align: center

compartment_levels <- paper_compartment_l3 |>
  dplyr::distinct(.data$paper_compartment) |>
  dplyr::pull(.data$paper_compartment)

if (!exists("baseline_compartment_draws")) {
  baseline_compartment_draws <- predict_res |>
    dplyr::inner_join(
      paper_compartment_l3 |>
        dplyr::distinct(.data$paper_compartment, .data$cell_type),
      by = "cell_type"
    ) |>
    dplyr::group_by(
      .data$paper_compartment,
      .data$age_decade,
      .data$sex,
      .data$.draw
    ) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      compartment_proportion = sum(.data$proportion),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

ctrl_panel_meta <- composition_ctrl_baseline |>
  dplyr::distinct(
    .data$sample_id_observed,
    .data$sex,
    .data$age_decade,
    .data$paper_compartment
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    sample_panel = paste0(
      .data$sample_id_observed,
      " (",
      .data$sex,
      " | decade ",
      .data$age_decade,
      ")"
    )
  )

ctrl_panel_order <- composition_ctrl_baseline_summary |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    sample_panel = paste0(
      .data$sample_id_observed,
      " (",
      .data$sex,
      " | decade ",
      .data$age_decade,
      ")"
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(.data$pct_consistent), .data$sample_id_observed)

ctrl_density_draws <- ctrl_panel_meta |>
  dplyr::inner_join(
    baseline_compartment_draws,
    by = c("sex", "age_decade", "paper_compartment")
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    sample_panel = factor(
      .data$sample_panel,
      levels = ctrl_panel_order$sample_panel
    ),
    paper_compartment = factor(.data$paper_compartment, levels = compartment_levels)
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    is.finite(.data$compartment_proportion),
    .data$compartment_proportion >= 0
  )

ctrl_density_vlines <- composition_ctrl_baseline |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    sample_panel = paste0(
      .data$sample_id_observed,
      " (",
      .data$sex,
      " | decade ",
      .data$age_decade,
      ")"
    ),
    sample_panel = factor(
      .data$sample_panel,
      levels = ctrl_panel_order$sample_panel
    ),
    paper_compartment = factor(.data$paper_compartment, levels = compartment_levels),
    p_label = sprintf(
      "p_above=%.2f\np_below=%.2f",
      .data$p_above_healthy,
      .data$p_below_healthy
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(.data$proportion_observed)) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    ctrl_density_draws |>
      dplyr::group_by(.data$sample_panel, .data$paper_compartment) |>
      dplyr::summarise(
        x_mid = stats::median(.data$compartment_proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = c("sample_panel", "paper_compartment")
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    text_hjust = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$proportion_observed > .data$x_mid,
      1.05,
      -0.05
    )
  )

ggplot2::ggplot(
  ctrl_density_draws,
  ggplot2::aes(x = compartment_proportion)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_density(
    fill = "grey80",
    color = "grey35",
    alpha = 0.55,
    linewidth = 0.35,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(
    data = ctrl_density_vlines,
    ggplot2::aes(
      xintercept = proportion_observed,
      color = baseline_agreement
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.75
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(
    data = ctrl_density_vlines,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = proportion_observed,
      y = Inf,
      label = p_label,
      hjust = text_hjust
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    vjust = 1.05,
    size = 2.1,
    lineheight = 0.85,
    color = "grey15"
  ) +
  ggplot2::facet_grid(
    sample_panel ~ paper_compartment,
    scales = "free",
    labeller = ggplot2::labeller(
      .cols = ggplot2::label_wrap_gen(10),
      .rows = ggplot2::label_wrap_gen(16)
    )
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(
    values = ctrl_baseline_cols,
    name = "CTRL vs\nmatched null"
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.04, 0.06))) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "CTRL donors vs sex/age-matched healthy atlas (density grid)",
    subtitle = paste(
      "Rows = CTRL donor (sex | age decade); columns = paper compartments.",
      "Grey = healthy predictive draws for that donor's metadata;",
      "vertical line = observed CTRL proportion;",
      "labels = p_above_healthy / p_below_healthy."
    ),
    x = "Compartment proportion",
    y = "Density"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_bw() +
  ggplot2::theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    strip.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
    strip.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 7),
    panel.spacing = grid::unit(0.25, "lines")
  )
```

**Read:** donors sorted by **% compartments consistent** (top = closest to atlas). Widespread non-green tiles mean in-study controls are **not** drawn from the same reference as Immune Atlas healthy PBMCs for those compartments — relevant when interpreting SAVI vs atlas (and gene-level CTRL drift). The **density grid** shows the same comparison panel-by-panel: a line inside the grey band supports consistency; a line in the tail matches the heatmap colour.

### Healthy atlas comparison (plots)

Tail tests and visualizations below use **sex/age-matched** healthy **`predict_res`** draws (`composition_matched_reference`).

```{r}
#| label: plot-savi-atlas-direction-heatmap
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 7
#| fig-align: center

# empirical_confidence = 2 * min(P(draw>=obs), P(draw<=obs)): near 0 = strong tail;
# near 1 = central. Signed score: direction x (1 - empirical_confidence).
heatmap_data <- composition_savi_vs_healthy |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Category = factor(.data$Category, levels = c("SAVI", "SAVI_treated")),
    atlas_strength = 1 - .data$empirical_confidence,
    atlas_signed_score = dplyr::case_when(
      .data$direction_vs_healthy == "higher_than_healthy" ~ .data$atlas_strength,
      .data$direction_vs_healthy == "lower_than_healthy" ~ -.data$atlas_strength,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    direction_short = dplyr::case_when(
      .data$direction_vs_healthy == "higher_than_healthy" ~ "↑",
      .data$direction_vs_healthy == "lower_than_healthy" ~ "↓",
      TRUE ~ "·"
    ),
    tile_label = sprintf(
      "%s\n%.2f",
      .data$direction_short,
      .data$atlas_strength
    ),
    sample_label = paste0(.data$sample_id_observed, " (", .data$Category, ")"),
    paper_compartment = factor(
      .data$paper_compartment,
      levels = unique(paper_compartment_l3$paper_compartment)
    )
  )

score_lim <- max(abs(heatmap_data$atlas_signed_score), na.rm = TRUE)
score_lim <- if (is.finite(score_lim) && score_lim > 0) score_lim else 1

ggplot2::ggplot(
  heatmap_data,
  ggplot2::aes(
    x = paper_compartment,
    y = sample_label,
    fill = atlas_signed_score
  )
) +
  ggplot2::geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(
    ggplot2::aes(label = tile_label),
    size = 2.4,
    lineheight = 0.85,
    color = "grey15"
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#377EB8",
    mid = "grey92",
    high = "#E41A1C",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-score_lim, score_lim),
    oob = scales::squish,
    name = "Signed evidence\nvs healthy"
  ) +
  ggplot2::facet_grid(.data$Category ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "SAVI donors: strength of deviation from healthy atlas (unified compartments)",
    subtitle = paste(
      "Tail test vs sex/age-matched healthy draws (not pooled across all decades).",
      "Red = higher, blue = lower; intensity = 1 - empirical confidence."
    ),
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_bw() +
  ggplot2::theme(
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1, size = 8),
    axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 7),
    strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```

```{r}
savi_density_vlines <- savi_cohort_atlas |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    sample_panel = factor(
      .data$sample_panel,
      levels = savi_panel_order$sample_panel
    ),
    paper_compartment = factor(.data$paper_compartment, levels = compartment_levels),
    p_label = sprintf(
      "p_above=%.2f\np_below=%.2f",
      .data$p_above_healthy,
      .data$p_below_healthy
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(.data$proportion_observed)) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    savi_density_draws |>
      dplyr::group_by(.data$sample_panel, .data$paper_compartment) |>
      dplyr::summarise(
        x_mid = stats::median(.data$compartment_proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = c("sample_panel", "paper_compartment")
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    text_hjust = dplyr::if_else(
      .data$proportion_observed > .data$x_mid,
      1.05,
      -0.05
    )
  )

ggplot2::ggplot(
  savi_density_draws,
  ggplot2::aes(x = compartment_proportion)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_density(
    fill = "grey80",
    color = "grey35",
    alpha = 0.55,
    linewidth = 0.35,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(
    data = savi_density_vlines,
    ggplot2::aes(
      xintercept = proportion_observed,
      color = baseline_agreement
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.75
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(
    data = savi_density_vlines,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = proportion_observed,
      y = Inf,
      label = p_label,
      hjust = text_hjust
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    vjust = 1.05,
    size = 2.1,
    lineheight = 0.85,
    color = "grey15"
  ) +
  ggplot2::facet_grid(
    sample_panel ~ paper_compartment,
    scales = "free",
    labeller = ggplot2::labeller(
      .cols = ggplot2::label_wrap_gen(10),
      .rows = ggplot2::label_wrap_gen(16)
    )
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(
    values = atlas_null_cols,
    name = "Donor vs\nmatched null"
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.04, 0.06))) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "SAVI and SAVI_treated donors vs sex/age-matched healthy atlas (density grid)",
    subtitle = paste(
      "Rows = donor (Category · sex | age decade); columns = paper compartments.",
      "Grey = healthy predictive draws for that donor's metadata;",
      "vertical line = observed proportion;",
      "labels = p_above_healthy / p_below_healthy."
    ),
    x = "Compartment proportion",
    y = "Density"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_bw() +
  ggplot2::theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    strip.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
    strip.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 7),
    panel.spacing = grid::unit(0.25, "lines")
  )
```

**How to read vs the paper**

1. **Observed cohort trends** (boxplot / bar chart): within-study CTRL vs SAVI vs SAVI_treated using observed proportions only (paper Figure 1E style). **`composition_paper_summary`**: `delta_savi_minus_ctrl` and `matches_paper_savi` flag agreement with published SAVI vs control direction.
2. **Healthy baseline by age** (line chart): how female vs male compartment proportions change across age decades 1–4 in **`predict_res`** (context for sex/age matching).
3. **CTRL vs atlas** (`plot-composition-ctrl-baseline-heatmap`, `plot-composition-ctrl-baseline-density`): sample × compartment heatmap plus per-donor density grid — grey curve = sex/age-matched healthy draws; line = observed CTRL proportion.
4. **Healthy atlas comparison** (heatmap, count/agreement bars): per donor × compartment tail test vs sex/age-matched **`predict_res`** draws (`composition_matched_reference`, `composition_savi_vs_healthy`).
5. **Compartment density plot** (`plot-composition-compartment-density`): same donor × compartment grid as CTRL — matched healthy density, tail-coloured line, **p_above** / **p_below** labels (**SAVI** and **SAVI_treated**).
6. **Fine-grained L3 table** (`composition_vs_healthy`): per donor × L3, `direction` and `empirical_confidence` with the same tail convention as gene-level deviation tests.
